article.title: What you need to know about Robert Kraft, the pro-Israel billionaire who pressured Ed Sheeran to drop Macklemore
article.author: Michael Arria
article.content: Robert Kraft got Macklemore ousted from Ed Sheeran's tour over "Free Palestine." A look at the NFL owner's record makes it clear why: funding the IDF, fighting BDS, courting Netanyahu, and bringing football legends on tours of Israel.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
